description: This file defines multiple classes related to monitoring aggregation dimensions for Azure Event Hubs within the Orleans streaming infrastructure. It includes base and derived classes for different monitor dimensions, such as for receivers, caches, and block pools.

classes.name: EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions
classes.description: Base class representing general monitoring dimensions related to an Event Hub, mainly encapsulating the EventHubPath.

classes.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Derived class extending the base dimensions with specific information about the EventHub partition being monitored.

classes.name: EventHubCacheMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Extends receiver monitor dimensions adding the BlockPoolId, used for cache monitoring within the EventHub ecosystem.

classes.name: EventHubBlockPoolMonitorDimensions
classes.description: Derived class focused on block pool monitoring, including BlockPoolId to identify the specific block pool.

methods.name: EventHubMonitorAggregationDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing the EventHubPath, and a parameterless constructor

methods.name: EventHubReceiverMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing with dimensions and partition, plus a parameterless constructor

methods.name: EventHubCacheMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing with dimensions, partition, and BlockPoolId, plus a parameterless constructor

methods.name: EventHubBlockPoolMonitorDimensions
methods.description: Constructor initializing with dimensions and BlockPoolId, plus a parameterless constructor
